Style: polished simple playful 2D mobile-game cartoon illustration, thick gently rounded silhouettes, clean shapes, restrained soft local shading, cheerful saturated palette, smooth opaque object interiors and clean antialiased cutout edges. Draw a completely new illustration from the subject description. Composition: one centered readable compact vignette that fills 80% of a square canvas, all subjects fully inside the canvas with comfortable padding. True transparent background. No backdrop rectangle, no card, no frame, no heading, no written words, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no padlocks, no external cast shadow or drop shadow, no surrounding glow. Subject: A compact playful group of three children playing with bright blue futuristic toy ray blasters, in cheerful white space-play suits. In the center back, a smiling fair-skinned boy with orange side-swept hair wears a white suit with cyan gloves and cyan trim and raises one hand. In front-left, a fair-skinned red-haired child in a pale blue suit holds a small blue toy blaster. At the right, a smiling dark-skinned girl with short black hair and red protective play goggles floats playfully in a white suit with bright pink gloves and boots, holding a small blue toy. A short electric-blue toy light beam connects the play action. Entire group fits in a compact readable triangular portrait vignette, characters fully visible, no enclosing room, no floor, no backdrop rectangle, no guns that look realistic.
